\section*{Problem Sheet 1: Statics}

The beam below carries a load $W$ at its midpoint.
\includegraphics[width=0.2\textwidth]{figures/ball.png}

\begin{enumerate}
\item Find the reaction at each support.
\item Find the bending moment at the midpoint.
\end{enumerate}

\section*{Solutions}

1(a) $W/2$ at each support.

1(b) $M = WL/4$
